variants.headline: Looking back: party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A party's leader was being challenged in {colony}.

The gazette notes the challenge as an internal political development. It records neither a change of leader nor the result of any contest. A reliable account should retain that distinction, particularly where a challenge encourages speculation about outcomes before the organisation has an established decision to report.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

Our assessment of {target} is critical. Political leadership should withstand serious questioning, and an internal challenge is no reason to suspend the demanding standards that public responsibility properly requires.

variants.headline: Looking back: leadership becomes a contested question
variants.sub: The leadership of a political party is under challenge.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: A challenge to a party leader had opened in the colony.

The gazette notes the challenge as an internal political development. It records neither a change of leader nor the result of any contest. A reliable account should retain that distinction, particularly where a challenge encourages speculation about outcomes before the organisation has an established decision to report.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

Our assessment of {target} is critical. Political leadership should withstand serious questioning, and an internal challenge is no reason to suspend the demanding standards that public responsibility properly requires.

variants.headline: Looking back: a challenge inside the party
variants.sub: A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The leadership of a political party was under challenge.

The gazette notes the challenge as an internal political development. It records neither a change of leader nor the result of any contest. A reliable account should retain that distinction, particularly where a challenge encourages speculation about outcomes before the organisation has an established decision to report.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

Our assessment of {target} is critical. Political leadership should withstand serious questioning, and an internal challenge is no reason to suspend the demanding standards that public responsibility properly requires.
